items.name: The Legend Of Karna
items.overview: A warrior from the Mahabharata who is born to Kunti and the Sun God Surya but raised in a charioteer’s household. He possesses the gift of bow mastery that rivals the greatest warriors of his age, compelling him to enter a grand tournament usually reserved only for kings and princes, altering the course of an empire forever.

items.name: Pritam And Pedro
items.overview: The dynamic between the two contrasting personalities, a seasoned cop who prefers old-school methods and a tech-savvy cop who relies on modern technology for investigations, as they navigate their partnership in solving crimes.

items.name: Sangamarmar
items.overview: Amrita sacrifices her budding romance with Aditya to fulfill family responsibilities. Their tender love endures through years of separation, becoming a poignant tale of sacrifice, silent strength, and unchanging devotion.

items.name: Declassified: Operation Sindoor
items.overview: Following the Pahalgam terror attack in April, India's military leadership deliberates and plans Operation Sindoor, an 88-hour military operation launched on May 7, featuring accounts from operatives and experts.

cast.name: Air Chief Marshal A. P. Singh

items.name: Chiraiya
items.overview: Kamlesh's world as a devoted wife and daughter-in-law shatters when her new sister-in-law confides a disturbing secret about her wedding night, forcing Kamlesh to confront uncomfortable truths within her own family.

items.name: Secret Stories: Roslin
items.overview: A 17-year-old girl is plagued by nightmares of a green-eyed stalker, pulling her into a spiral of fear and despair.

items.name: The Revolutionaries
items.overview: The Revolutionaries narrates the inspiring tale of brave young Indian freedom fighters who fought for ending British Raj with their unwavering spirit and ideology.

items.name: Hunkkaar: The Roar
items.overview: When a teenager accuses a revered cult leader of sexual assault, it sparks a national conflict. As the truth unravels, the line between faith and justice blurs.

items.name: Prince Of Mollywood
items.overview: Firoz has one dream: become a Pan-Indian superstar. But everyone around him has other plans. His friends are experts at ruining things. Vappa Mammali turns producer hoping one flop will send him straight back to the family business. Umma is busy finding him a bride on matrimony sites. And then there's his girlfriend.

items.name: The Secret Of The Shiledars
items.overview: A secret society unravels a hidden treasure belonging to Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, with Rajeev leading the quest to protect it from falling into wrong hands, ultimately becoming the chief of the Shiledars.

items.name: Mistry
items.overview: Armaan Mistry is a brilliant ex-cop, who can solve the toughest of cases with no qualms. Just one problem: he has extreme OCD.

items.name: When Life Gives You Tangerines
items.overview: In Jeju, a spirited girl and a steadfast boy's island story blossoms into a lifelong tale of setbacks and triumphs — proving love endures across time.

items.name: The Lord of the Rings The Rings of Power
Ayali
items.overview: Young Tamizhselvi dreams of becoming a doctor. But her village, Veerappannai, has fearsome age-old customs and traditions which inadvertently suppress women of the village. Will she be able to overcome them?

items.name: Thank You Teacher
items.overview: Twenty-five-year-old Ko dreams of becoming a teacher. As a child, she was saved by Chaichana, an event that made Ko want to be a good teacher like Chaichana. However, she comes to question what it is to be a good teacher. Ko becomes a teacher as she had hoped, but being a teacher is not easy when she has to face with the education system and the administration of Phatham School.

items.name: The Walking Dead Dead City
items.overview: Maggie and Negan travel to post-apocalyptic Manhattan - long ago cut off from the mainland. The crumbling city is filled with the dead and denizens who have made it a world full of anarchy, danger, beauty, and terror.

items.name: Ray
items.overview: From a satire to a psychological thriller, four short stories from celebrated auteur and writer Satyajit Ray are adapted for the screen in this series.

items.name: My Mowgli Boy
items.overview: Mo Geli was raised by his grandfather in the forest where he grew up playing with animals. Ling Xi accidentally brings Mo Geli with her back to the city. The two live under the same roof and grow to develop feelings for one another.

items.name: Breaking Bad
items.overview: Walter White, a New Mexico chemistry teacher, is diagnosed with Stage III cancer and given a prognosis of only two years left to live. He becomes filled with a sense of fearlessness and an unrelenting desire to secure his family's financial future at any cost as he enters the dangerous world of drugs and crime.

items.name: Man Vs. Wild
items.overview: Bear strands himself in popular wilderness destinations where tourists often find themselves lost or in danger.

items.name: A Love Other than Yours
items.overview: A realistic, emotionally resonant romance about a couple in their tenth year together whose comfortable relationship is tested by unexpected feelings.

items.name: Alif Laila
items.overview: Alif Laila is a TV series based on the stories from The Arabian Nights. Produced by Sagar Films, two seasons were made; the first aired on DD National and the second on SAB TV. The series covers well- and lesser-known stories from One Thousand and One Nights.

cast.name: Sunil Pandey
cast.character: Sabeer Ahmed (Three Brothers arc), Ali Baba (Ali Baba arc), thief Gufraan (Sinbad arc), vizier Sarbaakh (Two Brothers arc)

items.name: Ben 10 Ultimate Alien
items.overview: With his secret identity now revealed to the world, Ben Tennyson continues to fight evil as a superhero with the help of the newly acquired Ultimatrix.

items.name: Vincenzo
items.overview: During a visit to his motherland, a Korean-Italian Mafia lawyer gives an unrivaled conglomerate a taste of its own medicine  with a side of justice.
